summary: Canonical 'places' table is currently specialized for cultural atlas destinations (Job 1). Inserting 189 utility entities (ATM, FUEL_STATION, POLICE_STATION, FIRE_STATION, local CHC/HOSPITAL) into 'places' without domain-model corrections will cause severe leaks into tourist discovery, itinerary solvers, and search suggestions, and violates the 'NO VERIFIED IMAGE = NO PUBLIC DESTINATION' invariant.

findings: Place model has no 'domain_type' or 'entity_domain' discriminator (all rows treated as places/destinations).
Category table contains 23 categories: 20 leisure categories, plus 'hospital', 'emergency_facility', and 'transit_hub'.
Categories 'police_station', 'fire_station', 'atm', 'fuel_station' DO NOT EXIST in the database.
Attempting to insert candidates with new category foreign keys requires inserting unclassified categories.
GET /api/places executes SearchService.search_places.
Non-leisure suppression is hardcoded via NON_LEISURE_CATEGORIES: frozenset({'hospital', 'emergency_facility', 'transit_hub'}).
If 'police_station', 'fire_station', 'atm', 'fuel_station' are added, they are NOT in NON_LEISURE_CATEGORIES.
General /api/places browse queries will return ATMs and petrol pumps alongside Konark Sun Temple and Chilika Lake.
ItineraryService and replacement engines call SQLAlchemyPlaceRepository.list_verified_places(include_non_leisure=False).
This query filters ~Category.name.in_(NON_LEISURE_CATEGORIES).
Because ATM, police_station, fire_station, and fuel_station are absent from NON_LEISURE_CATEGORIES, they WILL be loaded as leisure destinations and scheduled into tourist day itineraries.
SearchCorrectionService._initialize_targets inspects Place table.
Line 75 contains a legacy check 'if cat_id in (14, 15, 16): continue' which fails on UUID PKs.
Adding 189 utility entities to places table will flood destination search suggestions with bank branches and petrol pumps.
Core project rule: 'NO VERIFIED IMAGE = NO PUBLIC DESTINATION'.
Validation runner and media pipeline require verified authentic WebP photographs for public places in places.json / places table.
Utility entities (ATMs, fuel pumps, police outposts) do not have tourist photographs in manifest.json and cannot satisfy this gate without breaking or exempting the rule.
DestinationsPage and Explore Atlas render places fetched from GET /api/places.
Utility places would appear as destination cards with 'Plan Trip', 'Save Place', and hero images.
In contrast, the frontend ALREADY possesses a dedicated 'EssentialsSection' and 'NearbyFacilities' component consuming /api/v1/services/* from 'data/services/odisha_services.json'.

existing_architecture_alignment.job_1_discover_places: Curated catalog of 204 verified places spanning heritage, craft, nature, coastal, and culinary destinations (data/places/places.json, PostgreSQL places table).
existing_architecture_alignment.job_8_find_nearby_services: Audited civic amenities mapped to destinations via precomputed proximity relationships (data/services/odisha_services.json, EssentialsService, /api/services/*).

option_1_recommended.name: Clean Domain Separation via Services Layer
option_1_recommended.description: Quarantine the 189 utility candidates to the dedicated services domain (data/services/odisha_services.json or a dedicated PostgreSQL services table) rather than polluting the tourist places catalog.
option_1_recommended.hospital_enrichment: Perform in-place enrichment on the 12 existing canonical hospitals in places table (since they already exist in places and are already protected by NON_LEISURE_CATEGORIES).
option_1_recommended.utility_promotion: Insert the approved utility write-set into the services dataset/table consumed by EssentialsService and /api/services/nearby.
benefits: Zero leakage into tourist discovery, itineraries, or recommendations.
Preserves 'NO VERIFIED IMAGE = NO PUBLIC DESTINATION' invariant intact.
Aligns 100% with PRODUCT.md Job 1 vs Job 8 boundary.

option_2.name: Unified Places Schema with Domain Classifier & Non-Leisure Quarantine
option_2.description: Add domain_type (DESTINATION vs CIVIC_UTILITY) to places table, insert categories into categories table, and extend NON_LEISURE_CATEGORIES across all backend search, ranking, and suggestion services.
tradeoffs: Requires database migration on places table.
Requires modifying NON_LEISURE_CATEGORIES across multiple files.
Requires updating media validation rules to exempt CIVIC_UTILITY from image requirements.
